paper_title: Cosmological bounds on pseudo Nambu-Goldstone bosons
notes: Paper presents cosmological bounds on ALP two-photon coupling g (GeV^-1) vs ALP mass m_phi in Figs. 1 and 2, spanning a broad slope g ∝ m^-3/2 for various constraints (Neff, BBN D/He, EBL, CMB distortions, DM overproduction, etc.). However, the numerical exclusion boundaries are given only as plots; no explicit table of (mass, coupling) pairs is provided. Only isolated relations exist, e.g. Eq. 3.11: g/GeV^-1 ≳ 1e-3*(eV/m_phi)^3/2 (validity boundary of Neff bound), and the DM mass m_phi < 154 eV. Cannot reliably extract a full exclusion curve of numeric points from text alone, hence data_points left empty.
